newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - PageNet sub growth trimmed.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - PageNet sub growth trimmed.

text.p: -- Goldman Sachs said it trimmed its estimate of Paging Network Inc core domestic subscriber growth rate to 25 percent from 27 percent, which reduces net additions to 2.2 million from 2.4 million.
-- said its subscriber estimate for the first quarter was lowered to 525,000 from 575,000.
-- said the change in guidance on subscriber growth reflects a company focus on cash flow and conserving capital and does not reflect a slowdown in the underlying growth dynamic of the business.
-- PageNet shares shed 2-3/16 to close at 10-3/16.
-- said considers it too early to make any definitive judgements about the progress of the company's VoiceNow product.
-- maintained its consolidated cash flow estimates of $62 million for the first quarter and $280 million for the fiscal year.
